ground_cache/promenade.json axis for level -1 Niki-de-Saint-Phalle-Promenade storefront walls

meta.verified_rule: verified=true if OSM check_date/survey date >= 2025-06-01 or confirmed by a web source in 2026; else false
meta.sign_note: sign colours/fonts are approximate brand CI from knowledge (source=brand_ci_approx) or generic guesses (generic_guess) - NOT taken from Street View; refine with on-site photos
meta.facade_note: facade.normal points from the storefront wall into the public space (street / promenade). wall_point lies on the LoD2 ground outline (or promenade side wall at level -1).
